thread:
maria: FYI team — short quiet window tonight 00:30-01:00 UTC. Need final pin + rollback criteria for API, runtime, router, console. I already uploaded release notes: https://confluence.redwood/release/3way-2026
kevin: Thanks — what are the exact versions we plan to land?
maria: API v2.4.1, runtime v3.7.0-rc2, router v1.8.2, console v0.9.5. Runtime is the riskiest due to kernel changes.
tom: Can we do a staged traffic shift? 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 15m windows. If latency p50 rises > 120ms or errors > 0.3% during a stage, rollback to previous variant.
sara: Agree on the staged plan. For pinning: API and router are backward compatible; we'll pin runtime model variant to quant-16 for the first hour. If memory OOMs observed, immediate rollback.
maria: Adding concrete rollback triggers:
- runtime: sustained GPU OOMs or >2% 5xx over 5m -> immediate rollback
- api: >=1% 5xx over 10m OR spike in p99 latency >500ms -> rollback
- router: route misrouting or header drop observed -> rollback
- console: UI errors >0.5% -> rollback to 0.9.4
kevin: Noted. Who owns the rollback action? ops on-call executes the pin rollback command, eng leads approve.
tom: I can be primary for runtime rollback. Maria will own API rollback approval. Kevin will watch router.
maria: I'll post release notes and a single-line deploy summary in #release-war-room before we start. Deploy bot will post status.
deploy-bot: Deploy start acknowledged. Initiating canary 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 5m checks. Commands:
```
/deploy start --svc api=2.4.1 runtime=3.7.0-rc2 router=1.8.2 console=0.9.5 --canary 5,25 --window 30m
```
kevin: If canary fails at 25%, we manually hold and run `deploy-bot rollback --to previous` — don't auto-rollforward without an ops ack.
sara: Also add a temporary header-swap so traffic to the new router can be forced for a subset of clients for deeper tests.
tom: Good call. I'll flame test logs for kernel warnings: look for `nvmlError` and `kernel_batch_mismatch` in runtime logs.
maria: After final cutover, we'll keep intensive telemetry for 2 hours and run the smoke evals suite. If any eval regression >3% on our rouge-like metric, we will revert.
kevin: All set on my side. I'll be at my keyboard 00:20-01:40 UTC.
sara: I'll stand by for router metrics and the header-swap toggle.
maria: OK start at 00:30 UTC. tagging @ops for on-call handoff. :rocket:
